title: SKFG
teaser: Design systems, experimentation, and brand KPI instrumentation across growth surfaces.
headline: A system for keeping design, documentation, and experimentation pointed at the same brand problem.
challenge: Growth work was spread across UX, customer engagement, and brand surfaces that could drift apart without strong system governance.
outcome: Ali managed the design system, tightened documentation loops, and paired experimentation with KPI tracking across a large body of copy and creative tests.
bullets: Managed design systems to create unity between UX and customer engagement design processes.
Met with design teams weekly to ensure consistency in Notion documentation with Figma embeds.
Oversaw KPI development for brand performance using 1,500 copywriting A/B tests with Notion AI and Python.
